question: The People for the Ethical Treatment of Animals, India, have conferred ______ with the 'Hero to Animals Award’ in 2020.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Naveen Patnaik**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **People for the Ethical Treatment of Animals (PETA) India** has honoured **Odisha Chief Minister Naveen Patnaik** with the **'Hero to Animals Award.'**
 
• During the lockdown in Odisha, due to the new coronavirus outbreak, he earned the award for providing funding to feed communal animals.</
